strings: !This program cannot be run in DOS mode.
Please enter your organization or company name and your serial number:
Multiple comments on one line are not allowed in the simulator input file.
Solution:  Modify the SI file so that each line has a maximum of one complete comment.  Note, single comments may begin and end on seperate lines.
The input file contains invalid bus value specifications.
2.  The digits within the bus value specifiers " " or ' ' do not reflect the base value of the simulation file.  Example: a hexadecimal value has been entered for a file with an octal base.

1.  Non numeric digits have been entered for each bus value bit setting within the " " or ' ' specifiers.  If bits are being specifically set, omit the " " or ' ' specifiers.  Eample: 'LHL' and "***" are invalid, they should be coded as LHL and *** without the quotes.
3.  There are incomplete bit field or bus definitions in the variable declarations of the orders clause.  Bit field and bus definitions must be present and complete in the ORDER: statement.
2.  There are too few variables defined in the ORDER: clause for the number of vector values defined in the VECTORS: section.
1.  There are too many variables defined in the ORDER: clause for the number of vector values defined in the VECTORS: section.
The input file contains vector information that is not fully defined by the variables in the ORDER: statement.
2.  Two or more variable names are the same disregarding case.  WinSim recognizes "var" and VAR" as the same variable.
The input file contains duplicate signal names for two or more variables in the ORDER: statement.
1.  Single variable signal names have been duplicated.

3.  Bit field or bus variables have been split into two or more sets of bit fields with the same name.  The first form of the following example causes this error and should be changed to the second form to eliminate the error.

Warning: This computer program is protected by copyright law and international treaties.  Unauthorized reproduction or distribution of this program, or any portion of it, may result in severe civil or criminal penalties
Z - Test output for high impedence
0 - Drive Input Low (Click lower left side of cell)
1 - Drive Input High (Click upper left side of cell)
L - Test Output Low (Click lower right side of cell)
H - Test Output High (Click upper right side of cell)
Z - Test high impedence (Left click middle of cell)
P - Preload internal registers (Alt click middle of cell)
X - Untested (Shift Left click middle of cell)
* - Simulator determined (Ctrl Left click middle of cell)
C - Clock Lo,Hi,Lo (Click upper side of cell)
K - Clock Hi,Lo,Hi (Click lower side of cell)
